A-80 — Starting selection brief
Manufacturer: Boya Gongdao

A floating and crawling underwater platform described by the manufacturer for contact cleaning, with cavitation water-jet and brush configurations subject to application review.

Vehicle weight: 100 kg
Depth rating: 300 m
Payload: 15 kg
Dimensions: 880 × 710 × 490 mm
Cameras: Two HD cameras
Power: External tethered supply

Configuration note: The manufacturer brochure describes a Baihetan intake trash-rack application. This does not establish suitability for every rack or replacement of fixed debris-raking machinery.

Confirm current specifications and delivered scope with the manufacturer before purchase.
